import pyaudio
from google.cloud import speech_v1p1beta1 as speech

RATE = 16000
CHUNK = int(RATE / 10)  # 100ms


def stream_microphone_audio():
    language_code = "en-US"

    client = speech.SpeechClient()
    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
        sample_rate_hertz=RATE,
        language_code=language_code,
        # Google Speech-to-Text requires a model for streaming, specifying video as a common use case.
        model="video",
        # Enable automatic punctuation for better readability.
        enable_automatic_punctuation=True,
    )

    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
        config=config,
        interim_results=True,
    )

    p = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    stream = p.open(
        format=pyaudio.paInt16,
        channels=1,
        rate=RATE,
        input=True,
        frames_per_buffer=CHUNK,
    )

    print("* Listening...")

    requests = (
        speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=audio_chunk)
        for audio_chunk in generate_audio_chunks(stream)
    )

    responses = client.streaming_recognize(streaming_config, requests)

    for response in responses:
        yield response


def generate_audio_chunks(stream):
    while True:
        chunk = stream.read(CHUNK)
        yield chunk

import asyncio
from google.cloud import speech_v1p1beta1 as speech


async def stream_audio_chunks(audio_source_async_iter):
    language_code = "en-US"

    client = speech.SpeechClient()
    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
        sample_rate_hertz=16000,
        language_code=language_code,
        model="video",
        enable_automatic_punctuation=True,
    )

    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
        config=config,
        interim_results=True,
    )

    async def request_generator():
        async for chunk in audio_source_async_iter:
            yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk)

    requests = request_generator()
    responses = await client.streaming_recognize(streaming_config, requests)

    async for response in responses:
        yield response

from google.cloud import speech_v1p1beta1 as speech


def start_streaming_recognizer(
    sample_rate_hertz: int,
    language_code: str = "en-US",
    enable_automatic_punctuation: bool = True,
):
    client = speech.SpeechClient()
    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
        sample_rate_hertz=sample_rate_hertz,
        language_code=language_code,
        model="video",
        enable_automatic_punctuation=enable_automatic_punctuation,
    )

    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
        config=config,
        interim_results=True,
    )

    return client, streaming_config

from google.cloud import language_v1


def check_for_unsafe_content(text: str):
    client = language_v1.LanguageServiceClient()

    document = language_v1.Document(
        content=text, type=language_v1.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT
    )

    # Available categories: https://cloud.google.com/natural-language/docs/moderating-content
    response = client.moderate_text(document=document)

    unsafe_categories = []
    for category_filter in response.moderation_categories:
        # The score is a confidence score from 0 to 1. Higher scores indicate higher confidence.
        # A threshold of 0.7 is commonly used for flagging content.
        if category_filter.score > 0.7:
            unsafe_categories.append(
                f"{category_filter.name} (score: {category_filter.score:.2f})")

    return unsafe_categories

from transformers import pipeline


def summarize_meeting_transcript(text_chunks: list[str]) -> str:
    # Using a local model for summarization for demonstration purposes.
    # In a real-world scenario, you might use a hosted API like Google Cloud's AI Platform
    # or a dedicated summarization service.
    summarizer = pipeline("summarization", model="sshleifer/distilbart-cnn-12-6")
    full_transcript = " ".join(text_chunks)
    summary = summarizer(full_transcript, max_length=150, min_length=50, do_sample=False)
    return summary[0]["summary_text"]

from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer


def embed_caption_chunk(text: str):
    # Using a local sentence transformer model for embedding.
    # For a production system, consider a hosted embedding service or a more scalable solution.
    model = SentenceTransformer("all-MiniLM-L6-v2")
    embedding = model.encode(text)
    return embedding.tolist() # Convert numpy array to list for easier serialization
